task.description:
Re-gate after TEST-DESIGNER rework1 — verify OBP-02 AC6 gap is now fixed.

Re-run all 5 checks on the updated test files:
1. MUST-priority AC coverage
2. No deferred coverage (especially OBP-02 AC6 — the test must now call flushRefusalEvents() and assert emitted event payload)
3. Fixture isolation
4. Self-sufficiency

Return PASS if all issues are resolved.

result.summary: All 5 checks pass for OBP-01/OBP-02/OBP-03/DDL-03 after rework1. MAJOR gap resolved: TC-OBP-02-AC6 now calls bpm.effects_worker.flushRefusalEvents() with a real RefusalEventQueue and asserts committed row carries event_type=EXECUTION_INGRESS_REFUSED with tenant_schema, depth=50000, cap=50000. Check 1 (coverage): all ACs have implemented tests. Check 2 (no deferred): no deferred label; AC6 exercises real flush path. Check 3 (fixture isolation): per-test UUID tenant names, TestHarness rollback, defer cleanup in AC6. Check 4 (self-sufficiency): requireTestDbUrl() fails loudly; AC6 starts own pool. Check 5 (build wiring): test-integration-obp01-depth / test-integration-obp02 / test-integration-obp03 / test-ddl-generate present with correct named-module imports; zig build check exits 0. MINOR fixes confirmed: OBP-02 AC5 test name aligned to obp02 stale cache returns 429 fail-closed; OBP-01 AC2 description updated for lockless readCached taking no conn parameter.
